drivers.name: Recent trend
drivers.why: Over the last 30 days the price fell 14.9% once the usual seasonal effect is taken out. The forecast carries that direction forward but lets it fade each day, so about 65% of it is kept over the next 30 days.

drivers.name: Season
drivers.why: In the seasonal pattern (from 9 years of prices) the price is usually 0.5% lower in 30 days' time (Nov) than now (Oct).

drivers.name: Last few days' average
drivers.why: Today's price is in line with the last 5 days - no effect.

forecast_reason.range: 80% of past misses fell inside -24.7% to +9.0% at 30 days, so that is the likely range.
forecast_reason.trust: Tested on 244 past dates: off by 11.5% on average at 30 days, vs 10.1% for "price stays the same" - it is NOT better than no-change here, so read it as a range, not a number. Direction right 55% of the time.
forecast_reason.blind: It reads only the price's own trend and season. It can't see US interest-rate moves, war or crisis news, central-bank buying, or an import-duty change in the Budget - news like that can move the price outside the range.

rules.english:
2026-10-26 Silver - BUY (score +1 of 5): If buying: Buy gradually, in parts.  If holding: Hold - don't rush to sell.
Why: Mainly because the price is in the cheap part of the year's range.
What would change it: Turns WAIT if the price rises to Rs 1,95,101 (+11.2%). Stays BUY even if it falls 15%.
How sure: Low. Past BUY days (936 since 2017): higher 30 days later on 66% vs 55% of all days -> edge +11 points.
Price: Rs 1,75,372 per kg (Rs 1,80,633 with 3% GST); 7 days -5.2%, 30 days -16.9%. 30-day outlook Rs 1,56,585 (likely Rs 1,32,002 - Rs 1,91,149).
Saving for years: GO SLOW - The long-run signs are weak right now: keep the small regular buys, but avoid one big purchase now. Because the long wave is down (below the 200-day average). Not counted (its record disagrees): Price vs 3-year average.
rules.telugu:
2026-10-26 వెండి - కొనండి (స్కోరు +1 / 5)
ఎందుకు: ముఖ్య కారణం: ధర ఈ ఏడాది పరిధిలో తక్కువ భాగంలో ఉంది.
ఏది మారిస్తే మారుతుంది: ధర Rs 1,95,101 (+11.2%) కి పెరిగితే వేచి ఉండండి. ధర 15% తగ్గినా ఇదే సూచన.
నమ్మకం: తక్కువ. గతంలో BUY రోజుల్లో (936 రోజులు) 30 రోజుల తర్వాత 66% సార్లు ధర పెరిగింది; ఏ రోజైనా 55% (తేడా +11).
ధర: కిలోకు Rs 1,75,372 (GST తో Rs 1,80,633); 7 రోజుల్లో -5.2%, 30 రోజుల్లో -16.9%. 30 రోజుల అంచనా Rs 1,56,585 (Rs 1,32,002 - Rs 1,91,149).
ఏళ్ల తరబడి దాచుకునేవారికి: నెమ్మదిగా కొనండి - దీర్ఘకాల సంకేతాలు ఇప్పుడు బలహీనంగా ఉన్నాయి: చిన్న క్రమమైన కొనుగోళ్లు కొనసాగించండి, ఇప్పుడు ఒకేసారి పెద్ద మొత్తం కొనకండి. కారణం: దీర్ఘకాల ధోరణి కిందికి ఉంది (200 రోజుల సగటు కింద).
